# apim_documentation_portal (Resource)

DocumentationPortal Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apim_portal" "developer-portal" {
  hrid = "developer-portal"
  name = "[Terraform] Developer Portal"
  navigation = [
    {
      path         = "/docs/getting-started"
      display_name = "Getting Started"
      order        = 1
    }
  ]
}

resource "apim_documentation_portal" "getting-started" {
  portal_hrid = apim_portal.developer-portal.hrid
  hrid        = "getting-started"
  name        = "Getting Started"
  type        = "GRAVITEE_MARKDOWN"
  location    = "/docs/getting-started"
  order       = 1
  content     = <<-EOT
  # Getting Started

  Welcome to the next-gen developer portal.

  This page demonstrates multiline Markdown content managed with Terraform.
  EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) The content of the documentation page
- `hrid` (String) A unique human readable id identifying this resource. Requires replacement if changed.
- `name` (String) Display name of the documentation page
- `portal_hrid` (String) Human-readable ID of a portal
- `type` (String) The type of documentation page. must be one of ["GRAVITEE_MARKDOWN", "OPENAPI", "ASYNCAPI"]

### Optional

- `environment_id` (String) environment ID
- `location` (String) The path in the navigation hierarchy where this page should appear.
- `order` (Number) Display order relative to siblings at the same location
- `organization_id` (String) organization ID

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apim_documentation_portal.getting-started
  id = jsonencode({
    environment_id  = "DEFAULT"
    hrid            = "getting-started"
    organization_id = "DEFAULT"
    portal_hrid     = "developer-portal"
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apim_documentation_portal.getting-started '{"environment_id": "DEFAULT", "hrid": "getting-started", "organization_id": "DEFAULT", "portal_hrid": "developer-portal"}'
```
